q: How do I work out BRSR environment energy and emissions from a year of bills?
title: BRSR energy and emissions from bills
short: Total each fuel and electricity for April to March, multiply by its emission factor for Scope 1 and 2, and by its energy content for GJ. 480,000 kWh, 12,000 litres of diesel and 3,000 kg of LPG give about 382 t CO2 and about 2,301 GJ.
audience: MSMEs and listed companies filling BRSR environment fields

ol: Add up kWh from twelve electricity bills.
Add up litres and kilograms from fuel invoices.
Emissions: grid kWh x 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh (CEA); diesel litres x 2.68; LPG kg x 2.98.
Energy: kWh x 0.0036 GJ; diesel litres x about 0.0359 GJ; LPG kg x 0.0473 GJ.
Report Scope 1, Scope 2, total energy and the renewable share separately.

ul: Twelve months present for every connection.
Diesel used in generators counted as Scope 1, not Scope 2.

example.title: Worked example
lines: Scope 1 = 41.1 t; Scope 2 = 340.8 t; total about 381.9 t CO2.
Total energy about 2,300.7 GJ, all non-renewable.

senseible: Senseible reads kWh, litres and kg from electricity bills and fuel invoices into a dated record per site, with the factor and source on every line, and prepares BRSR drafts from that data. Reports are self-declared drafts.
